about: Golden vectors for evidence segment format v3 (DAN-343, contract on #896). All data is invented.
v3 is v2 with one more source, citation-form; every other rule of v2 holds. These vectors add to evidence-v2.json and change none of it.
Derived outside the repository code: Python json.dumps with sorted keys and compact separators (JCS for this ASCII data) and hashlib.sha256. Never regenerate them from the code under test.

accepted.name: v3-citation-form
accepted.note: A citation inserted by the Literatura form between two typed events: v3.

accepted.name: v3-v2-sources-only
accepted.note: v3 does not have to carry citation-form.

accepted.name: v2-same-events
accepted.note: The same events as v3-v2-sources-only in v2: only the schema differs.

rejected.name: v3-source-citation
rejected.note: A near value is not citation-form.

rejected.name: v3-unknown-field
rejected.note: The closed key set of v2 holds for v3.

rejected.name: v3-broken-document-chain
rejected.note: Event hashes chain in v3 as in v2.

receiptV2.note: A receipt v2 payload naming schema v3: the digest D-92 signs is over these bytes, unchanged in form.
